summary: Wildland #2 tower built 1937 by the CCC for the Kentucky Division of Forestry; moved near US 68/KY 80 around 1964 and still stands there as the Bald Knob Tower.

facts.design: 80-foot Aermotor LS-40 tower with a 7'x7' metal cab
facts.status_note: Original site is gone; the tower was moved around 1964 and still stands at its new location on US 68/KY 80 (FFLOS); NHLR says the U.S. Forest Service owns it
facts.agency: Kentucky Division of Forestry (original); U.S. Forest Service (now, per NHLR)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR's Built field says 1964, but its own description and the FFLOS record give 1937 as the build year. The story uses 1937 for construction and 1964 for the move.
Two registers number the tower separately: FFLOS US 1744, KY 5 for the original site and NHLR US 831, KY 7 for the Bald Knob Tower. Both are kept.

corrections.why: The original site is gone, but FFLOS says the tower was moved around 1964 and still stands at its new location, and NHLR lists it as owned by the U.S. Forest Service.

notes_for_editor: Brief status 'gone' is right for the original site but wrong for the tower: moved around 1964 and standing as the Bald Knob Tower (FFLOS, NHLR). NHLR gives separate coordinates (36.78, -88.058) for the Bald Knob Tower, which presumably mark its current site; FFLOS coordinates are the original site. No source found on public access or climbing; check with Land Between the Lakes. Nothing found on what remains at the original site. Search summaries mentioned foundation piers and a Golden Pond visitor-center location; these were not verified and are not used. No photos collected (NHLR photo captions not extracted).
